ay.name: Ayatollah
ay.passive: Steadfast: infantry near him recover from suppression twice as fast and take 15% less damage from artillery and aircraft. Path of Hussein: when one of your infantry falls near him a green banner rises for 20 s; comrades near a banner hit 8% harder (up to 3 banners).

ability.name: Sermon
ability.text: Sermon (120 s): he raises his hand and a green halo spreads 320 around him. For 25 s your ground units inside it are Inspired: +20% rate of fire, +15% speed, and they cannot be suppressed. [E]

ultimate.name: Call to Arms
ultimate.text: Call to Arms (300 s): drums and chant - 6 volunteer riflemen muster at him and at each of your barracks. [Shift+E]

dl.name: Dear Leader
dl.passive: On-the-spot guidance: a production building next to him builds 25% faster; artillery and rockets near him reload 15% faster. Unbreakable Spirit: wounded units near him keep full damage and speed, and damaged vehicles repair themselves slowly.

ability.name: Supreme Commander's Order
ability.text: Supreme Commander's Order (120 s): loudspeakers and red banners - pick a target; every artillery and rocket unit within 320 of him fires one free synchronized volley there, then fires 25% faster with +15% range for 25 s. [E]

ultimate.name: Mass Mobilization
ultimate.text: Mass Mobilization (300 s): siren - for 20 s infantry train 50% faster and 25% cheaper, and 8 Worker-Peasant Guards (militia) form at each of your barracks. [Shift+E]
